All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Action
An action is a story graph symbol that represents an event in a story.
ActionList
The list of actions, events that can occur in a story graph to change the current state of a story from one node to another.
ArchiveReader
A story graph reader that reads from a ZIP archive file.
ArchiveWriter
A story graph writer that writes to a ZIP archive file.
ArrayPlan
A plan that stores a sequence of actions in an array.
BigArrayList<T>
A custom implementation of an array list which can hold up to BigArrayList.MAX_CAPACITY elements and which uses long integers to index elements and to measure its BigArrayList.size().
Character
A character is a story graph symbol that represents one of the agents in a story.
CharacterList
The list of characters, or agents, who take actions and have possibly wrong beliefs in a story graph.
Commented
A story graph element that can have a String comment associated with it.
Consenting
Provides methods to reason about which characters consent to a single action or sequence of actions.
DirectoryReader
A story graph reader that reads from a directory.
DirectoryWriter
A story graph writer that writes to a directory.
Edge
An edge represents a directed relationship from a tail node to a Edge.head node with a label in a story graph.
EdgeCollection
A collection of all edges in a story graph.
EdgeIterable<E extends Edge>
A collection of edges.
EdgeList<E extends Edge>
A collection of edges of the same type.
EpistemicEdge
An epistemic edge models what a character believes a node's state to be.
EpistemicEdgeList
The list of epistemic edges in a story graph, which represent each character's beliefs about the current state of a story.
Explanation
An explanation is a plan that a character wants to take at a specific node in a story graph.
ExplanationList
The list of explanations in a story graph, which document the plans that a character wants to taken in a given node.
ExplanationSubset
A subset of explanations that belong to a specific node.
FilterIterator<T>
A wrapper around an Iterator that returns only the elements for which a Predicate returns true.
Fluent
A fluent is a story graph symbol that represents a variable in a world state can can have one of several possible values which might change when an action happens.
FluentList
The list of fluent, or state variables, in a story graph.
GraphReader
An interface for reading a story graph from an input source.
GraphWriter
An interface for writing a story graph to an output destination.
LinkedList<T>
A custom implementation of a singly linked list.
MergeIterator<T>
An iterator that returns all elements of two other iterators.
MetaData
A table for storing meta information about a story graph.
Node
A node represents a specific moment in a story graph; it defines a value for every fluent, a numeric utility value for the story and each character, possible futures represented by its temporal edges, and the beliefs of each character represented by its epistemic edges.
NodeEdgeCollection
A collection of all edges that have a specific node as their tail or head.
NodeEdgeGroup<E extends Edge>
Contains both the incoming and outgoing edges of a certain type for a node.
NodeEdgeIterable<E extends Edge>
A collection of some edges related to a specific node.
NodeEdgeList<E extends Edge>
A collection of edges of the same type associated with a specific node.
NodeEdgeList.In<E extends Edge>
A collection of edges of the same type which have the same node as their head.
NodeEdgeList.Out<E extends Edge>
A collection of edges of the same type which have the same node as their tail.
NodeExplanationList
A collection of explanations associated with a specific node.
NodeList
The list of nodes in a story graph, which represent specific moments in the story, including what actions can happen and what beliefs characters have about the state.
NominalValue
A nominal value is a story graph symbol that can be assigned to a Fluent in a node's state.
Numbered
A story graph element with a unique sequential long ID number.
NumberedList<N extends Numbered>
A collection of numbered story graph elements of the same type.
NumericValue
Numeric values represent numbers and are singleton objects that exist in all story graphs without needing to be explicitly defined in the value list.
Plan
A plan is a specific sequence of actions.
PlanList
The list of plans in a story graph, which as sequences of actions.
Sequence
A sequence of actions, such as a plan or explanation.
Settings
Constants used by the story graph library.
State
A state defines a value for each fluent and a numeric utility value for a story and each character in a story graph.
StateList
The list of states in a story graph, which assign a value to each fluent and a numeric utility values to each character.
Status
An object that can be periodically updated to reflect the progress of a long-running operation.
StoryGraph
A story graph represents moments in a story as nodes, how actions can change the state of the story world (temporal edges), what each character believes about the state (epistemic edges), and what each character plans to do (explanations).
StoryGraphCollection<T>
A collection of story graph elements.
StoryGraphList<T>
A collection of story graph elements that are all of the same type and have sequential ID numbers starting at 0.
Symbol
A story graph element with a unique sequential int ID number, a unique name, and an optional comment.
SymbolList<S extends Symbol>
A collection of symbols of the same type.
TailPlan
A plan formed by prepending a single action to an existing plan (i.e.
Task
A task is any process that may take a long time to run and which can update a status object to reflect its current progress.
TemporalEdge
A temporal edge models how the state of a node changes after an action occurs.
TemporalEdgeList
The list of temporal edges in a story graph, which represent how actions can change the state of a story from one node to another.
Utilities
Common utility functions needed by multiple classes.
Value
A value is anything that can be assigned to a fluent in a state.
ValueList
The list of nominal values in a story graph.
